intro: Bundles of Wood are tied timber stacks harvested by laborers near the Eastvale Logging Camp in eastern Elwynn Forest. Recently abandoned due to prowling wildlife, they represent critical shipments needed to fulfill local lumber contracts.

p: The Eastvale Logging Camp serves as a primary source of lumber for the Kingdom of Stormwind, sending freshly chopped wood westward to sustain town infrastructure and construction projects. Recently, aggressive local wildlife—specifically forest bears and prowling wolves—pushed into the groves northwest of the camp. Terrified loggers fled for their lives, abandoning freshly gathered Bundles of Wood where they lay among the trees. Facing tight delivery deadlines, camp overseers rely on brave travelers to slip past the predators and retrieve the cut lumber before contracts are breached.
